lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed in a semi-regular grid pattern across the lateral flank; cluster diameter and spacing remain relatively constant in the mid-flank region with increased density near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity defined by the alignment of circular blobs, creating a grid-like structure across the mid-to-upper flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Dominant horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, bright horizontal linear feature on the upper anterior flank, oriented parallel to the primary ridge, suggesting a healed incision or physical trauma.
